name: GRIEFS Texture Ripper
detailed_description:
Revolutionize your texturing pipeline with GRIEFS Texture Ripper - the essential toolkit for game developers, 3D artists, and digital creators.

Extract perfect textures from any image using powerful tools like advanced perspective correction and intelligent cropping. Automatically generate high-definition PBR maps - including Normal, Displacement, Ambient Occlusion, Metallic, and Roughness - to bring stunning realism to your models and environments.

Enhance even the lowest-quality images with integrated AI upscaling, transforming blurry or dated textures into crisp, production-ready assets in seconds.

Unleash Unprecedented Realism and Efficiency

INSTANT LIVE PREVIEWS
Watch your edits come to life in real time. Texture Ripper’s live visual feedback eliminates guesswork and accelerates your workflow, helping you iterate faster with total creative control.

POWERFUL PBR MAP GENERATION
Automatically generate essential maps - Normal, Displacement, AO, Metallic, and Roughness - from any texture. Add rich detail and physical depth to your 3D assets with a single click.

AI-POWERED UPSCALING
Breathe new life into low-resolution sources. Our built-in AI enhances textures intelligently, preserving critical surface details and generating new ones - saving hours of manual cleanup.

Streamline Your Workflow with Intuitive Features

Flexible Extraction & Manipulation

  • Perspective Warping - Flatten textures from photographs or angled surfaces with perfect accuracy.

  • Cropping Mode - Precisely define and isolate texture areas with no warping.

  • Grid System & Snapping - Achieve pixel-perfect alignment with a customizable grid.

  • Drag & Drop + Image Pasting - Effortlessly bring in single or multiple images into your project.

Creative Optimization & Customization

  • Texture Upscaling & Downscaling - Export at any resolution to meet project needs, from AAA realism to retro pixel art.

  • Retro Texture Mode - Instantly generate pixelated or lo-fi textures for stylized aesthetics.

  • UI Scaling & Custom Layouts - Tailor the interface to your workspace and screen size.

Robust Project Management

  • Project Management & Autosave - Work with confidence using automatic save and load support.

  • Layer Management - Organize, edit, and composite textures across multiple layers.

  • Atlas Packing - Combine multiple assets into clean, optimized atlases for real-time engines.

And We're Just Getting Started

GRIEFS Texture Ripper is continuously evolving. Expect regular updates packed with innovative features, smarter tools, and deeper creative flexibility - all designed to push the boundaries of what texture creation can be.

Whether you're a solo developer, an indie artist, or a professional studio - GRIEFS Texture Ripper will transform the way you build, edit, and export textures.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics Card
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: VRAM 8GB for AI Upscaling
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: VRAM 16GB for AI Upscaling
